description.en: Connects Qwen Code to a local AOCI MCP server so the agent reads and maintains a repository's governed cognition index.
description.zh: 把 Qwen Code 接入本机 AOCI MCP 服务，让 Agent 读取并维护仓库的受治理认知索引。

aoci.description: Bundled AOCI 0.2.0-rc3 cognition server (stdio, linux/amd64). Requires a repository initialized with `aoci init` + `aoci scan`.
